about_title: Four-side bending with no tooling changes
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with European and Japanese controls and hydraulics — Delem, Estun, Schneider, Siemens, NOK — inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, as every machine we sell.

A panel bender clamps the blank once and forms every side — up, down, hems, box corners — in 0.2 s per bend while a manipulator turns the part: boxes, doors, enclosures, cabinets and HVAC panels in sheet to 14 ga, five to ten times faster than a press brake and without a skilled operator. The PB-M uses a patented press arm to feed and support the blank, with 15 servo axes, in nine sizes from 63 to 165″; the PB-A adds a 0.5 s automatic tool changer and 26 – 28 axes so parts with different flanges on every side run untouched, in four sizes to 126″. Robot loading cells are available for both.
